description: This file defines a PHP class 'InputStream' that extends 'NativeResource' and provides methods for reading from and seeking within an input stream, interfacing with native code via the AWS CRT library.

classes.name: InputStream
classes.description: A class that wraps a native input stream, providing PHP methods for input operations such as read, seek, and end-of-file detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InputStream with a PHP stream, creating a native resource and associating it with the PHP stream.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native resource when the InputStream object is destructed.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream based on an offset and basis.
